conclusion: Record structure exposes finite field alphabets and a joint floating/decimal field. Global compositions restrict unique-key permutations and repeated date/value arrangements. Using remaining counts saves 45878 physical full-file bytes over fixed probabilities with exactly the same dictionaries and count metadata. Arithmetic coding is 104 bytes smaller than conditional permutation ranks on the full file; ranks win the three PAQ-backed regional controls by 9 to 20 bytes. The substantial improvement comes from the predictive constraints, not an intrinsic rank-coder information advantage.
